This choice is made at character creation, and can only be changed with retraining.

traits.name: Weather Savvy
traits.text: Ixal are so in tune with the air and sky (whether they are on their airships or on the ground) that they can sense the slightest change in atmospheric conditions. They can spend a full-round action to predict the weather in an area for the next 24 hours. This prediction is always accurate, but cannot account for spells or supernatural effects that might alter the forecast.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Ixal have claws both on their hands and receive two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage. These are primary natural attacks but can be used on either hands or feet depending on how they attack.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Ixal have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Kindreds are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Kindreds are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Kindreds have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Kindreds begin play speaking Common and either Abyssal or Infernal. Kindreds with high intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Infernal, Lalafellen, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Fiendish Resistance
traits.text: Kindreds have shadow resistance 5, lightning resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.

traits.name: Tough Shell
traits.text: Kindreds have a thick outer shell that grants them a +1 natural armor to AC.

traits.name: Fearsome Might
traits.text: Kindreds gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate checks and may use their Strength score instead of their Charisma score for Intimidate checks.

traits.name: Spell-like ability
traits.text: Kindreds can use deeper darkness once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability equals the kindred’s class level.

traits.name: Fiendish Magery
traits.text: Kindred mages treat their Intelligence score as 2 points higher for all mage class features and spells.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Kindreds can see perfectly in the dark for up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Kobolds are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Kobolds are humanoids with the kobold subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Kobolds have a base speed of 30 feet and burrow speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Kobolds start off knowing Terran and Common. They can learn any of the beastmen languages. Kobolds can learn additional languages by putting ranks into the linguistics skill.

traits.name: Bond to the Land
traits.text: Kobolds have been mining for many generations and gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC when in caves and rocky terrain.

traits.name: Reckless Work
traits.text: Kobolds receive a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion, as well as any other ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments.

traits.name: Thick Hide
traits.text: Kobolds have thick hair all over them and gain a +1 natural armor bonus to their Armor Class.

traits.name: Cave Dweller
traits.text: Kobolds have vast knowledge on dungeons and survival and therefore gain a +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival checks made underground.

traits.name: Master Tinker
traits.text: Like goblins, kobolds are excellent at taking things apart, thought not as much as putting them back together and gain a +1 racial bonus on Disable Device skill checks. Kobolds are also treated as proficient with any non-exotic weapon they have personally crafted.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Kobolds have been on threatening terms of the Roegadyn-Galka of Lominsa as of recent and gain a +2 attack on attacks against them.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Kobolds have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Emissary
traits.text: Kobolds are decent on making trade offers to the once famous pirates of Lominsa and know exactly how to swindle their way into getting precious metals and ores. Once per day, kobolds can roll twice when making a Bluff or Diplomacy check and take the better roll.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Kojins are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Kojins are Humanoid creatures with the reptillian subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Kojins have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Kojins begin play speaking Common and Kojin. Kojin with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Hide in Shell
traits.text: As a full-round action, kojins may retract their body into their shell. This allows them to gain DR/5 Bludgeoning. It also allows for 20% concealment. When they use this ability, they immediately fall prone, drop anything they were holding, and any item that isn’t directly attached to their skin. While they are in this form, they cannot make attacks, use items, or cast spells. They must remain in this form for at least one complete round. To come out of their shell, they must spend another full round action (this does not provoke AoO).

traits.name: Shell
traits.text: Kojins have a natural armor bonus of +1.

traits.name: Natural Swimmers
traits.text: Kojins have a swim speed of 30 feet and as such they do not have to make a swim check in order to swim under normal circumstances. They have a +8 racial bonus to swim checks to perform a special action or avoid a hazard. Though kojins cannot breathe water, they are able hold their breath for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before making drowning checks. Nor do standard or full-round actions reduce this time.

traits.name: Skilled Traders
traits.text: Kojins gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature’s attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two.

traits.name: Eastern Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Kojins are proficient with the following weapons: katana and sai.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Kojins have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Water Sense
traits.text: Kojins can sense vibrations in water, granting them blindsense 30 feet against creatures that are touching the same body of water.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Lamias are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Lamias are Humanoid creatures with the reptillian subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Lamias have a base speed of 20 feet and a swim speed of 40 feet, but their speed is not modified by armor or encumbrance.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Lamias begin play speaking Common and Aquan. Lamias with high Intelligence scores can choose any of the following bonus languages: Aboleth, Aklo, Draconic, Elvaan, Sahagin, and Sylvan.

traits.name: Bond to the Land
traits.text: Lamias gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC when fighting on desert or water areas. Must pick one during character creation.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Lamias can hold their breath for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.

traits.name: Tough Scales
traits.text: Lamias have tough scales and gain a +1 natural armor bonus from it.

traits.name: Jeweler’s Craft
traits.text: Lamias are amazing crafters of both normal and magic jewelry and gain a +2 racial bonus on all Craft or Profession checks to create objects from metal.

traits.name: Slapping Tail
traits.text: Lamias can use their tails to make attacks of opportunity with a reach of 5 feet. The tail is a primary natural attack that deals 1d8 points of damage plus the user’s Strength modifier.

traits.name: Tripping Tail
traits.text: When lamias hits with their slapping tail, they can make a trip attack as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Lamias are proficient with scimitar and cutlass weapons.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Lamias have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Legless
traits.text: Lamias have no legs and cannot equip any leg or foot armor nor wear any foot magic items (essentially losing the foot slot for magical items), but they can wear any magical item for the neck slot around their tails (effectively able to wear two neck slot magical items). This also includes if a spell uses any polymorph effect (effectively not getting any benefits from a foot slot magical item even if polymorph effect allows it). This changes only if the character is resurrected to a different race.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Loporits are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Loporrits are Humanoid creatures with the rabbit subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Loporrits are fast for their size, and have a base speed of 40 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Loporrits begin play speaking Common and Loporrit. Loporrits with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Celestial, Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Nimble Faller
traits.text: Loporrits have an amazing sense of balance and keen knowledge of their own center of gravity. Loporrits land on their feet even when they take lethal damage from a fall and take damage as if the fall were 10 feet shorter than it actually is. Furthermore, loporrits gain a +1 bonus to their CMD against trip combat maneuvers.

traits.name: Handy
traits.text: Loporrits receive a +2 racial bonus on a Craft or Profession skill of their choice.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Loporrits receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.text: Loporrits use their Dexterity to modify Climb and Swim checks.

traits.name: Sprinter
traits.text: Loporrits gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Loporrits can see twice as far as humes in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Scent
traits.text: In addition to having low-light vision, loporrits have the scent ability.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Matangas are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Matangas are humanoids with the Matanga subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Matangas have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Matangas begin play speaking Common and Matanga. Matangas with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Elvaan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Matangas receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: The physical stature of Matangas lets them function in many ways as if they were one size category larger. Whenever a Matanga is subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a Combat Maneuver Bonus or Combat Maneuver Defense (such as during grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), the Matanga is treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to him. A Matanga is also considered to be one size larger when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect him. The benefits of this racial trait doesn’t stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change the subject’s size category.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Matangas receive a +4 bonus to their combat maneuver defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Academic
traits.text: Matangas receive a +2 racial bonus on a Knowledge skill of their choice. This knowledge skill count as class skills for the matangas.

traits.name: Craftsman
traits.text: Matangas are excellent craftsman. They gain a +2 racial bonus to Craft checks.

traits.name: Dexterous Trunk
traits.text: Matangas have a long, flexible trunk that can be used to carry objects. They cannot wield weapons with their trunks, but they can retrieve small, stowed objects carried on their persons as a swift action.

traits.name: Powerful Tusks
traits.text: Matangas have powerful tusks that they can gore people with, granting a gore attack as a natural weapon that deals 1d6 points of damage.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Matangas have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Namazus are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Namazus are Humanoid creatures with the namazu subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Namazus have a base speed of 30 feet. Namazus also have a swim speed of 30 feet and as such they do not have to make a swim check in order to swim under normal circumstances. They have a +8 racial bonus to swim checks to perform a special action or avoid a hazard.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Namazus begin with Common and Aquan. Namazus with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Draconic, Elvaan, Lalafellan, Mithran, Roegadyn, and Vieran.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Namuzus can hold their breath for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.

traits.name: Craftsman
traits.text: Namazus are avid tradesmen, creating their own wares for sale and gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft or Profession checks to create objects from cloth, leather, or wood.

traits.name: Craftsman Knowledge
traits.text: Namazus gain Knowledge (technology) and Knowledge (engineering) as class skills.

traits.name: Festive Culture
traits.text: Namazus receive a +2 racial bonus on Appraise, Disguise, and Perform checks.

traits.name: Skilled Traders
traits.text: Namazus gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature’s attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two.

traits.name: Water Sense
traits.text: Namazus can sense vibrations in water, granting them blindsense 30 feet against creatures that are touching the same body of water.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Orcs are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Orcs are humanoids with the orc subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Orcs have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Orcs begin play speaking Common and Orc. Orcs with high Intelligence scores can chose from the following: Dwarven, Giant, Kobold, Goblin, Moblin and Undercommon.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Orcs gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Skill Bonus
traits.text: Orcs gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatic checks made with this skill. Alternatively, Orcs also gain a +1 racial bonus on Climb and Jump Skills.

traits.name: Throw Anything
traits.text: Orcs will throw anything that it engages as a way for it to make sure it is the victor. Orcs gain the Throw Anything feat.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Orcs are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and any weapon with the word “orc” in its name.

traits.name: Ferocity
traits.text: Orcs possess the ferocity ability which allows them to remain conscious and continue fighting even if their hit point totals fall below 0. Orcs are still staggered at 0 hit points or lower and lose 1 hit point each round as normal.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Orcs have been known to attack travelers both in the early morning and dusk and therefore receive low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Qiqirns are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Qiqirns are Humanoid creatures with the qiqirn subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Qiqirns have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Qiqirns begin play speaking Common and Qiqirn. Qiqirns with high Intelligence scores can choose Aquan, Draconic, Kindred, Orc, Terran, and Yagudo.

traits.name: Curiosity
traits.text: Qiqirns are naturally inquisitive about the world around them. They gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) become class skills for them. If they choose a class that has either of these Knowledge skills as class skills, they gain a +2 racial bonus on those skills instead.

traits.name: Silver Tongued
traits.text: Unlike other races of Beastmen, Qiqirns are very talkative and eager to sell wares and set up trades with everyone and gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature’s attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two.

traits.name: Sociable
traits.text: When Qiqirns talk, they can go on and on attempting to wiggle their way in a chance to earn more respect with a person or beastmen (regardless how annoying they might be). Qiqirns that try to change a creature’s attitude with a Diplomacy check and fail by 5 or more can try to influence the creature a second time even if 24 hours have not passed.

traits.name: Sprinter
traits.text: Qiqirns gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Qiqirns have rat-like nails and receive a pair of claws they can use as natural weapons. These claws are primary attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage.

traits.name: Scent
traits.text: Qiqirns gain the scent ability.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Quadav are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Quadav are Humanoid creatures with the reptillian subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Quadav have a base speed of 20 feet and a 30 foot swim speed, but their speed is not modified by armor or encumbrance.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Quadav begin play speaking Common and Quadav with high Intelligence scores can choose Kindred, Terran, Aquan, Yagudo, Orc and Draconic.

traits.name: Bond to the Land
traits.text: Quadav gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC when fighting on swamp or underground areas. Must pick one during character creation.

traits.name: Full Withdrawal
traits.text: As a full-round action, quadav may retract their body into their shell. This allows them to gain DR/5 Bludgeoning. It also allows for 20% concealment. When they use this ability, they immediately fall prone, drop anything they were holding, and any item that isn’t directly attached to their skin. While they are in this form, they cannot make attacks, use items, or cast spells. They must remain in this form for at least one complete round. To come out of their shell, they must spend another full round action (this does not provoke AoO).

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Quadav can hold their breath underwater for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.

traits.name: Steel Shelled
traits.text: As a quadav gets older the harder its shell gets and gains a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cave Dweller
traits.text: Quadav gain a +1 bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival checks made underground.

traits.name: Craftsman
traits.text: Quadav gain a +2 racial bonus on all Craft or Profession checks to create objects from metal or stone.

traits.name: Master Tinker
traits.text: Quadav gain a +1 bonus on Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering) checks. Quadav are also treated as proficient with any weapon they have personally crafted.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Due to the shape of a quadav’s beak, they gain a natural bite attack that deals 1d4 damage. The bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Quadav live both on the land and deep within lit caves and, therefore, can see twice as far as humes in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Armor Non-Proficiency
traits.text: Due to their distinct body type, the quadav have to have pay double for their armor (unless crafting it themselves).

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Sahagins are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Sahagins are Humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Sahagins have a base speed of 30 feet and a 30 foot swim speed.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Sahagins begin play speaking Sahagin and Common. They can only learn any of the other beastmen languages.

traits.name: Bond to the Depths
traits.text: Sahagins gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC when in shallows and deep water terrain.

traits.name: Mist Child
traits.text: Deriving from the oceans and fog, whenever a sahagin has concealment or total concealment, the miss chance of attacks against her increases by 5%.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Sahagins have been blessed by their god, allowing them to breathe both in and out of the water making it ideal to fish and gather materials off of the sea floor for trading purposes.

traits.name: Weapon Proficiency
traits.text: Sahagins have been trained at birth to use tridents in hand to hand combat. They have been known to track and board trading ships throughout the generations and some have formed pirate crews to attack said ships. Sahagins are always proficient with tridents.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Sahagins have a natural bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Sahagins have two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage. These are primary natural attacks.

traits.name: Water Gun
traits.text: Once per day, sahagins are able to cast Water Gun using their Wisdom modifier for the saving throw and their level as the caster level.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Only diving down to the shallows for trinkets and food, they can see twice as far as a hume with normal vision in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Sylphs are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty on their combat maneuver checks and to Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Sylphs are fey with the sylph subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Sylphs have a base speed of 20 feet. They also have a fly speed of 40 feet (poor).

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Sylphs start out with Sylvan and Common. Sylphs with high Intelligence scores can learn from the following: Elvaan, Mandragoran, Mithran, or Vieran.

traits.name: Elemental Resistance
traits.text: Sylphs have lightning resistance 5.

traits.name: Magic Resistant
traits.text: Sylphs get a +1 racial saving throw bonus against spells or spell-like effects.

traits.name: Spell Resistance, Lesser
traits.text: Sylphs gain spell resistance equal to 6 + their character level.

traits.name: Beguiling Liar
traits.text: Sylphs gain a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince an opponent that what they are saying is true when they tell a lie.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.text: Sylphs are very familiar with the treespeak and the wooded areas of the Black Shroud and gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks while within that terrain type.

traits.name: Fey Magic
traits.text: Sylphs add +1 to the DC of any illusion spells they cast. They also gain the following spell-like abilities (the caster level is equal to the user’s character level, using their Charisma modifier):

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Sylphs have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Fast Healing
traits.text: Trollkins regain 1 hit point each round. Except for where noted here, fast healing is just like natural healing. Fast healing does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow lost body parts. Fast healing continues to function (even at negative hit points) until a trollkin dies, at which point the effects of fast healing immediately end.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Trollkins receive a +2 racial bonus on saves against fear spells and effects.

traits.name: Thick Skin
traits.text: Trollkins have a thick leathery skin that grants them a +1 natural armor to AC.

traits.name: Fearsome
traits.text: Trollkins gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate checks.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Trollkins possess a large toothy maw. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d6 points of damage.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Trollkins also possess claw-like hands. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d4 points of damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Trollkins can see perfectly in the dark for up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Acid or Fire
traits.text: When trollkins are subject to fire or earth damage, it temporarily turns off their fast healing for 1 minute.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Vanu are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Vanu are Humanoid creatures with the vanu subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Vanu have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Vanu start off with Common and Vanu. They can learn any of the beastmen languages. Vanu can learn additional languages by putting ranks into the linguistics skill.

traits.name: Desert Runner
traits.text: Due to their warm blood and adaptable feathers, vanu receive a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion, as well as any other ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments.

traits.name: Elemental’s Gift
traits.text: The elementals know that the Vanu Vanu are more susceptible to attacks from foreign races and monster and grant them their wind ability. Once per day, as a swift action, a vanu can grant himself a +2 deflection bonus to AC against ranged attacks for 1 minute.

traits.name: Heightened Elemental Resistance
traits.text: Due to both their physical merits and their time amongst the skies, the vanu are quite resilient to wind. Vanu gain wind resistance 10.

traits.name: Sleepless Magicks
traits.text: Vanu are known to go sea fishing for weeks on end without sleeping a wink and have immunities to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws made against enfeebling spells and effects.

traits.name: Gift of Tongues
traits.text: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks, and they learn one additional language every time they put a rank in the Linguistics skill.

traits.name: Sky Sentinel
traits.text: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls, a +2 dodge bonus to AC, and a +2 bonus on Perception checks against flying creatures. In addition, enemies on higher ground gain no attack roll bonus against vanu.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Vanu have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Velkks gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear effects.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Velkks receive a +4 bonus to their combat maneuver defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Water Resistant
traits.text: Velkks gain Water Resistance 5.

traits.name: Survivalist
traits.text: Velkks gain a +2 racial bonus on all Survival skill checks.

traits.name: Affinity for Magic
traits.text: Velkks have a natural affinity for magic, with many individuals displaying an innate talent for spellcasting. Velkks gain a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance and a +2 racial bonus on dispel checks.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Velkks can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Velkks can see twice as far as a hume in starlight, moonlight, tvelkkhlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. He retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.

traits.name: Scent
traits.text: Velkks gain the scent ability.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Yagudos are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Yagudos are Humanoid creatures with the yagudo subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Yagudos have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Yagudos begin play speaking Common and their own dialect of Yagudo. Yagudos with high Intelligence scores can choose any language as a bonus language.

traits.name: Feathers of Gale
traits.text: Yagudos have thick feathers that coat their body, giving themselves a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Stalker
traits.text: Perception and Stealth are always class skills for yagudo.

traits.name: Valiant Linguist
traits.text: Yagudos are very good with talking out their problems, establishing trade and setting up offerings in order to provide a type of peace and learn many different languages in order to keep that peace. They gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than 1 language.

traits.name: Zealot Devotee
traits.text: Yagudos being of the religious zealots gain a +2 to all Knowledge (Religion) checks and gain an additional +1 per 5 ranks in the skill.

traits.name: Biting Is the Last Resort
traits.text: Though yagudos don’t use their beaks for biting an opponent, they will use it if desperate enough to end the combat with their enemy. They all possess a bite natural attack that inflicts 1d4 points of damage on a hit. This is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the yagudo wields a manufactured weapon.

traits.name: Swordtrained
traits.text: Yagudo are trained from birth in swordplay, and as a result are automatically proficient with swordlike weapons (limited to scizores, cutlasses, daggers, falchions, greatswords, kukris, longswords, punching daggers, rapiers, scimitars, short swords, and sword canes).

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Yagudos have built huge buildings in order to practice their arts and be able to raise their young without interference from the outside world. All of their dark buildings are torch-lit and the young have been born to use this dimly-lit hallways and rooms to broaden their eyes distance in dim light. A yagudo can see twice as far as a hume in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. He retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Dwarves are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Dwarves are humanoids with the dwarf subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: (Slow and Steady) Dwarves have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Dwarves begin play speaking Common and Dwarven. Dwarves with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Bond to the Land
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC whenever they are underground like within caves and dungeons.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +4 racial bonus to their Combat Maneuver Defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Greed
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 racial bonus on Appraise checks made to determine the price of non-magical goods that contain precious metals or gemstones.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 bonus on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework, such as traps and hidden doors located in stone walls or floors. They receive a check to notice such features whenever they pass within 10 feet of them, whether or not they are actively looking.

traits.name: Master Tinker
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +1 bonus on Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering) checks. Dwarves are also treated as proficient with any non-exotic weapon they have personally crafted.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the orc and goblinoid subtypes because of their special training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Dwarves are proficient with battleaxes, heavy picks, and warhammers, and any weapon with the word “dwarven” in its name.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Dwarves can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Elvaans are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Elvaans are Humanoids with the elvaan subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Elvaans have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Elvaans begin play speaking Common and Elvaan. Elvaans with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Galkan, Goblin, Lalafellan, Mithran, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Elvaans gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear effects.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Elvaans receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Martial Background
traits.text: Elvaans receive the Weapon Focus feat for free at first level, and may apply it to any single weapon they are proficient in.

traits.name: Noble Upbringing
traits.text: Elvaans take great pride in their history, culture, and government. They receive a +2 bonus on Knowledge (nobility) and Knowledge (history) checks and treat these skills as class skills.

traits.name: Gatecrasher
traits.text: Elvaans gain a +2 racial bonus on Strength checks to break objects and a +2 racial bonus on combat maneuver checks to sunder.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Elvaans receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the orc and goblin subtypes due to special training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Elvaans are proficient with longbows (including composite longbows), longswords, rapiers, and shortbows (including composite shortbows).

traits.name: Low-light Vision
traits.text: An elvaan can see twice as far as a hume in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. He retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Galka are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Galka are humanoids with the galka subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: (Slow and Steady) Like dwarves, galka have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is not modified by armor or encumbrance.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Galka begin play speaking Common and Galkan. Galka with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Elvaan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Galka receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Galka receive a +4 bonus to their combat maneuver defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Imposing Figure
traits.text: Galka are intimidating without trying. They gain a +2 racial bonus to Intimidate checks.

traits.name: Mining Servitude
traits.text: Galka are used to being forced into the mines. They gain a +2 racial bonus on profession (miner) checks.

traits.name: Metalworker
traits.text: The galka have worked with metals most of their lives. They gain a +2 racial bonus to Appraise and Craft checks involving metal.

traits.name: Ferocity
traits.text: Once per day, when a galka is brought below 0 hit points but not killed, he can fight on for 1 more round as if disabled. At the end of his next turn, unless brought to above 0 hit points, he immediately falls unconscious and begins dying. (This acts as Orc Ferocity)

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Due to their history of war and being exploited, the galka gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against antica and hume.

traits.name: Relentless
traits.text: Galka gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to bull rush or overrun an opponent. This bonus only applies while both the Galka and its opponent are standing on the ground.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Galka are proficient with the War pick and Galkan racial weapons.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Galka have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Half-breeds are the size of one of their parent races of your choice, and receive bonuses and penalties accordingly.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Half-breeds are humanoid creatures with the subtypes of both of their parent races.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Half-breeds have a base speed equal to half their combined movement speed from their base races. If one or more base races have a fly, climb, or burrow speed, half-breeds gain half the movement amount instead or an average if both races possesses both movement modes.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Half-breeds begin play speaking Common and one other from their chosen base races. Half-breeds with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Blood
traits.text: Half-breeds count as both their base races for any effect related to race.

traits.name: Multitalented
traits.text: Chosen at first level, half-breeds have two favored classes instead of one, giving them favored class bonuses when they take a level in either of those classes.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Humes are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Humes are Humanoid creatures with a hume subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Humes have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Humes begin play speaking Common. Humes with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.text: Humes select one extra feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Curiosity
traits.text: Humes are naturally inquisitive about the world around them. They gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) become class skills for them. If they choose a class that has either of these Knowledge skills as class skills, they gain a +2 racial bonus on those skills instead.

traits.name: Integrated
traits.text: Humes gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff, Disguise, and Knowledge (local) checks.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Humes gain an additional skill rank at first level and one additional rank whenever they gain a level.

traits.name: Sociable
traits.text: When humes attempt to change a creature’s attitude with a Diplomacy check and fail by 5 or more, they can try to influence the creature a second time even if 24 hours have not passed.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Mithra are humanoids with the mithra subtype.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Mithra are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Mithra have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Mithra begin play speaking Common and Mithran. Mithra with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Elvaan, Lupin, Goblin, Lalafellan, Orc, and Vieran.

traits.name: Cat’s Luck (Ex)
traits.text: Once per day, when a mithra makes a Reflex saving throw, she can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. She must decide to use this ability before the saving throw is attempted.

traits.name: Lesser Defensive Training
traits.text: With their peaceful life being threatened by the yagudo, mithra tend to be more cautious around them. Mithra gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against yagudo.

traits.name: Nimble Faller
traits.text: Mithra have an amazing sense of balance and keen knowledge of their own center of gravity. Mithra land on their feet even when they take lethal damage from a fall and take damage as if the fall were 10 feet shorter than it actually is. Furthermore, mithra gain a +1 bonus to their CMD against trip maneuvers.

traits.name: Fleet-Footed
traits.text: Mithra receive Run as a bonus feat and a +2 racial bonus on initiative checks.

traits.name: Natural Hunter
traits.text: Mithra receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

traits.name: Sprinter
traits.text: Mithra gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Mithra have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Moogles are Humanoid creatures with the moogle subtype.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Moogles are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Moogles have a base speed of 20 feet on land. While moogle wings are too small to provide true flight, lingering remnants of their fey heritage allow moogles to achieve limited flight for short periods of time while wearing light or no armor and carrying no more than a light load. A moogle can fly with clumsy maneuverability a number of rounds at a time equal to his Constitution bonus. A moogle can attempt to fly for longer durations by making Constitution check each additional round of flight (DC 10 + 2 per extra round). A moogle’s natural fly speed is equal to his base land speed. After flying, a moogle must rest a number of rounds equal to twice the number of rounds spent flying before flying again. Additionally, a moogle gains +4 on Acrobatics checks as long as he is able to fly.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Moogles begin play speaking Common and Moogle. Moogles with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Auran, Banganese, Draconic, Goblin, Numish, Seeq, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Moogles gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Eternal Hope
traits.text: Moogles rarely lose hope and are always confident that even hopeless situations will work out. Moogles receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against fear and despair effects. Additionally, once per day, after rolling a 1 on a d20, the moogle may reroll and use the second result

traits.name: Emissary
traits.text: Once per day, moogles can roll twice when making a Bluff or Diplomacy check and take the better roll.

traits.name: Good Merchant
traits.text: Moogles seem to have the innate ability to identify the value of items and sell them at a good margin. Moogles receive a +2 racial bonus on all Appraise checks. Furthermore, moogles gain a +2 racial bonus on all Diplomacy checks concerning any type of business transaction.

traits.name: Handy
traits.text: Moogles receive a +2 racial bonus on a Craft or Profession skill of their choice.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Moogles receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Scavenger
traits.text: Moogles gain a +2 racial bonus on Appraise and Perception checks to find hidden objects (including traps and secret doors), determine whether food is spoiled, or identify a potion by taste.

traits.name: Construct Familiarity
traits.text: Moogles get a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against constructs and receive a +4 dodge bonus to AC against them.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Moogles can see twice as far as humes in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Hydrophobia
traits.text: When drenched in water or some other liquid, a moogle receives a –2 penalty on attack rolls and concentration checks.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Tarutarus are Humanoid creatures with the tarutaru subtype.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Tarutarus are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty to their Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: (Slow Speed) Tarutarus have a base speed of 20 feet on land.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Tarutarus begin play speaking Common and Lalafellan. Tarutarus with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Tarutarus get a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Magic Resistant
traits.text: Tarutarus get a +1 racial saving throw bonus against spells or spell-like effects.

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.text: Tarutarus gain a +2 racial bonus on Will saving throws to resist spells and spell-like abilities of the illusion school. In addition, if a tarutaru fails such a save, it receives another save 1 round later to prematurely end the effect (assuming the spell or spell-like ability has a duration greater than 1 round). This second save is made at the same DC as the first. If the tarutaru has a similar ability from another source, it can only use one of these abilities per round, but can try the other on the second round if the first reroll ability fails.

traits.name: Magic Expert
traits.text: Tarutarus value knowledge and learning about the field of magic. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (Arcana) and Spellcraft checks.

traits.name: Talented
traits.text: Tarutarus receive a +2 racial bonus on a Craft or Profession skill of their choice.

traits.name: Magic Aptitude
traits.text: Tarutarus gain a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance and a +2 racial bonus on dispel checks.

traits.name: Magick Focus
traits.text: Tarutarus gain a +2 racial bonus on concentration checks made to cast spells defensively.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
traits.text: Tarutarus can use detect magic at will as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to the tarutaru’s class level).

traits.name: Low-light Vision
traits.text: Tarutarus can see twice as far as a hume in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. They retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Half-gigas are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Half-gigas are Monstrous Humanoid creatures with the giant subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Half-gigas have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Half-gigas begin play speaking Common and Giant. Half-gigas with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Half-gigas receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Half-gigas have thick greasy skin, granting them a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: The physical stature of half-gigas lets them function in many ways as if they were one size category larger. Whenever a half-gigas is subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a Combat Maneuver Bonus or Combat Maneuver Defense (such as during grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), the half-gigas is treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to him. A half-gigas is also considered to be one size larger when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect him. The benefits of this racial trait doesn’t stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change the subject’s size category.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Half-gigas receive a +4 bonus to their combat maneuver defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Imposing Figure
traits.text: Half-gigas are intimidating without trying. They gain a +2 racial bonus to Intimidate checks.

traits.name: Slam
traits.text: Half-gigas gain a natural slam attack, dealing 1d6 points of damage. The slam is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the half-gigas is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Half-gigas can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Half-gigas can see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Lizardmen are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Lizardmen are Monstrous Humanoid creatures with the reptilian subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Lizardmen have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Lizardmen begin play speaking Common and Lizardman. Lizardmen with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Water Resistant
traits.text: Lizardmen gain a Water Resistance of 5.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Lizardmen have tough scaly skin, granting them a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Lizardmen can breathe both in and out of the water, making it ideal to fish and gather materials off of the sea floor for trading purposes.

traits.name: Fast Swimmer
traits.text: Lizardmen have a swim speed of 60 feet and thus gain a +8 racial bonus on Swim checks

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Lizardmen gain a natural bite attack, dealing damage equivalent to that of a creature two size categories lower than normal for their size (1d2 for Small races, 1d3 for Medium, etc.). The bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Lizardmen receive two claw attacks. These are primary natural attacks. The damage is based on the creature’s size (1d4 for Medium creatures.)

traits.name: Tail Slap
traits.text: Lizardmen have a long, prehensile tail that can be used to strike at out-of-reach targets. The tail slap deals 1d4 damage (for Medium creatures) and has an additional 5-ft. of reach. This natural attack counts as a secondary attack.

traits.name: Blindsense
traits.text: Lizardmen have blindsense with a range of 30 feet

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Lizardmen can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Lizardmen can see twice as far as humes in dim light.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Syrictas are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Syrictas are Humanoid creatures with the reptilian subtype.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Slow; Syricta have a base speed of 20 feet on land, and their speed is never modified by encumbrance or armor. They also have a fly speed of 40 feet (poor), an syricta’s wing span is typically 12 feet, and cannot fly in an area that does not allow them to fully extend their wings.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Syricta begin play speaking Common and Draconic. Syricta who have high Intelligence scores scores can choose from the following: Dwarvish, Elemental, Elvaan, Infernal, Kobold, Minotaur, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Dragonhide
traits.text: Syricta have a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Dragon Resistances
traits.text: Syricta gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws versus paralysis and sleep effects.

traits.name: Elemental Resistance
traits.text: Syricta must choose earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, or wind element at 1st level. They have elemental resistance 5 against that element type.

traits.name: Draconic Presence
traits.text: Syricta gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Diplomacy checks. Fly is always a class skill for syricta.

traits.name: Gliding Wings
traits.text: Syricta take no damage from falling (as if subject to a constant non-magical choco feather spell).

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Syricta gain a natural bite attack, dealing 1d6 points of damage. The bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the syricta is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: 3 times per day, the syricta can breathe out a 15-foot cone or 20-foot line (chosen at 1st level) of elemental energy. Creatures within the area of effect take 1d6 points of damage + 1d6 per two character levels of the same type as the elemental resistance racial trait. A Reflex save (DC 10 + half the syricta’s class level + the syricta’s Constitution modifier) reduces this damage by half.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Syricta gain a set of natural claw attacks, dealing 1d4 points of damage. The claws are a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the syricta is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Slapping Tail
traits.text: Syricta have a tail they can use to make attacks of opportunity with a reach of 5 feet. The tail is a natural attack that deals 1d8 points of damage plus the user’s Strength modifier.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Syricta have darkvision, allowing them to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Syricta can see twice as far as humes in dim light.
